contents.name: Section 5.4, cancellation, creation and handle addition (elementary modifications of a decomposition)

contents.reason: Degenerate critical points are outside the Morse hypothesis of this pair, and the example is used only to illustrate failure of the Morse counting.

contents.reason: Duality is proved on the published algebraic-topology page; this pair avoids it by using the relative homology of sublevel bands and the coefficient-free Euler identity.
